props.name: children
props.description: The ListView items. Use static ListViewItem children or a render function with `items`.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to render for dynamic collections.

props.name: isQuiet
props.description: Whether the ListView should draw without the default container chrome.

props.name: selectionStyle
props.description: How selection is visualized.

props.name: overflowMode
props.description: Whether labels and descriptions truncate or wrap.

props.name: hideLinkOutIcon
props.description: Hides the external-link trailing icon on link items.

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Loading state forwarded to load-more behavior.

props.name: renderActionBar
props.description: Provides an action bar when items are selected.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the grid list root element.

props.name: size
props.description: Legacy GridList size alias retained for compatibility.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy GridList variant alias retained for compatibility.

props.name: layout
props.description: Legacy GridList layout alias retained for compatibility.

props.name: columns
props.description: Legacy GridList columns alias retained for compatibility.

props.name: label
props.description: Legacy label helper. Prefer aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Legacy description helper.

props.name: id
props.description: ID for the grid list element.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler called when selection changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ARIA describedby for the grid list.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: ARIA label for the grid list.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ARIA labelledby for the grid list.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the grid list is disabled.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Currently selected keys (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Default selected keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: orientation
props.description: The primary orientation of the items. Usually this is the direction that the collection scrolls.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler for item actions.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Function to get the key from an item.

props.name: getTextValue
props.description: Function to get the text value from an item.

props.name: getDisabled
props.description: Function to check if an item is disabled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of disabled items.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: Whether disabled items can still receive focus.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: A function to render when the grid list is empty.

props.name: dragAndDropHooks
props.description: Drag and drop hooks from `useDragAndDrop`.

props.name: isVirtualized
props.description: Whether the grid list uses virtual scrolling.

props.name: shouldSelectOnPressUp
props.description: Whether selection should occur on press up.

props.name: keyboardNavigationBehavior
props.description: How keyboard navigation should behave within rows. `"arrow"` treats the collection as a single tab stop and uses arrow keys to move through row children. `"tab"` lets tabbable row children participate in normal tab order and stops child key events before collection navigation.

props.name: direction
props.description: The text direction, used to flip the inline navigation axis in a horizontal orientation.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether there are more items to load.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the load more sentinel becomes visible.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the ListViewItem.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((renderProps: GridListItemRenderProps) => JSX.Element)
props.description: The contents of the item.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether this item is disabled. Static collections support this directly; dynamic collections can also use `getDisabled`.

props.name: hasChildItems
props.description: Whether this item navigates into child content.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target metadata for visual parity with React Spectrum's link-out affordance.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description text. Prefer `<Text slot="description">`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon helper retained from the older GridList API.

props.name: image
props.description: Optional image helper retained from the older GridList API.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text for the image helper.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the rendered row element.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when the item is activated.

props.name: item
props.description: The item value.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text value of the item (for accessibility).
